_why: CP-5.2 rung 2. The contract's END state is the tool's own `_meta`, published by the owning service (CP-5.md §4). This file is the INTERIM home so a contract is authorable without waiting on another team — the same correction §3a/W1 already took for the ref/resolver map: 'a registry row, authored once and later pushed upstream into _meta when the owning service catches up'. `_meta` WINS wherever a service supplies it, and `Completeness.source` records which one answered so an owner-published contract and one we wrote never merge into one indistinguishable row.

identifier_resolution.book_id: an opaque id; resolve a book NAME with book_search before calling. No resolver is declared for it yet — 5.3 builds the ref/resolver map, and until it does a name here is refused rather than guessed.
identifier_resolution.chapter_id: an opaque id obtained from this same tool with kind=chapters.

argument_supplier.kind: model — the caller chooses what to list
argument_supplier.book_id: context | plan — the ambient book when the surface is book-bound (`_meta.scope: book`), otherwise a plan-bound value
argument_supplier.chapter_id: plan — emitted by a prior kind=chapters listing
argument_supplier.offset: plan — the runtime advances it while paging

repeat_semantics.signal_retained: A repeat MAY be served from cache to remove its cost. It is still COUNTED and the breaker still escalates — removing a repeat's signal is what turned a 393-call loop into 393 silent successes (§3).

error_contract.message: required on every failure; a failure carrying no message is unrepresentable

output_contract.shape: { items: [...], page: { total, returned, is_complete, guidance } }
output_contract.note: Declared so a CP-3 `emits` path is checkable at PLAN-BUILD time rather than failing at execution (§2).

result_completeness.surface: The runtime must surface is_complete=false to the model. A truncated page read as the whole answer is the quiet failure this member exists for — it appears in no error bucket.

preconditions.unmet: not advertised; the withholding is recorded
preconditions.note: kind=chapters|revisions|scenes additionally require book_id; kind=revisions requires chapter_id.

identifier_resolution.book_id: an opaque id; resolve a book NAME with book_search before calling.
identifier_resolution.chapter_id: an opaque id from book_list kind=chapters.
identifier_resolution.scene_id: an opaque id from book_list kind=scenes.

argument_supplier.book_id: context | plan — the ambient book when the surface is book-bound, otherwise plan-bound
argument_supplier.chapter_id: plan — emitted by a prior listing
argument_supplier.scene_id: plan — emitted by a prior listing
argument_supplier.offset: plan — the runtime advances it while paging a chapter body

repeat_semantics.signal_retained: Cached repeats are still counted and still escalate the breaker.

output_contract.shape: { book | chapter | scene, page: { total, returned, is_complete, guidance } }
output_contract.note: The DEEPEST id present decides which branch of the shape is returned.

result_completeness.surface: A chapter body is block-paged; a partially read chapter must not read as the whole chapter.

preconditions.unmet: not advertised; the withholding is recorded
preconditions.note: book_id is required; chapter_id/scene_id are optional and select a deeper read.
